component: iBoot / LLB Research Release Diagnostic Commands & Boot Arguments

diagnostic_shell.line_editor: VT100 serial terminal with command history buffer

reboot.description: Commands PMGR power controller to perform cold or warm hardware reset.

setenv.description: Sets volatile or NVRAM boot environment variable.

getenv.description: Retrieves current value of boot environment variable.

saveenv.description: Flushes volatile environment variable modifications to non-volatile storage.

reset.description: Initiates CPU pipeline reset and warm reboot.

nvram.description: Direct low-level NVRAM dictionary inspection and manipulation.

devicetree.description: Inspects or dynamically patches embedded DeviceTree node properties.

fsboot.description: Loads and boots signed bootloader or kernel image from local filesystem.

usb.description: Initializes or interrogates USB Type-C / DFU communication controller.

go.description: Transfers bare-metal execution control to designated memory address.

pmgr.description: Power Manager static tunables and clock mesh diagnostics.

memory.description: DRAM physical memory integrity test and range dumper.

stage2_dump.description: Research diagnostic: dumps Stage-2 translation descriptors for designated VMID.

boot_arguments.description: Kernel debugger control mask (DB_PRT | DB_SLT | DB_NMI | DB_HALT).
